title: Job Openings at St. Ives Specialist Hospital
content:
St. Ives Specialist Hospital is a leading multi-specialist healthcare facility established in 1996. The hospital provides dedicated specialist services in women’s health, children’s health, and family healthcare, delivered by a team of experienced consultants in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Medicine, and Surgery.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Fertility Counsellor

Job Location: Akowonjo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking a compassionate and experienced Fertility Counselor to provide emotional and psychological support to individuals and couples undergoing fertility treatments.
	The ideal candidate will have expertise in reproductive health, mental health counseling, and guiding patients through the challenges associated with infertility and assisted reproductive technologies (ART).


Key Responsibilities


	Provide individual and couples counseling to those experiencing fertility-related stress and emotional distress.
	Offer support in decision-making related to fertility treatments, including IVF, egg/sperm donation, surrogacy, and adoption.
	Conduct psychological assessments for patients undergoing third-party reproduction (e.g., egg/sperm donors and surrogates).
	Educate patients on coping strategies, stress management, and emotional well-being throughout their fertility journey.
	Work collaboratively with medical professionals, embryologists, and support staff to ensure a holistic approach to patient care.
	Facilitate support groups and educational workshops for individuals and couples facing fertility challenges.
	Maintain accurate and confidential patient records in compliance with ethical and legal guidelines.
	Stay updated on best practices, new treatments, and research in reproductive psychology and infertility counseling.


Qualifications & Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Psychology, Counselling, Social Work, or a related field
	Certification in fertility counselling (preferred) or experience working with patients undergoing fertility treatments.
	Strong knowledge of reproductive medicine, ART, and the emotional impact of infertility.
	Excellent communication, empathy, and active listening skills.
	Ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion and cultural competence.
	Experience facilitating support groups and counselling sessions.
	Proficiency in maintaining confidential patient documentation.


Application Closing Date: 2nd November, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position and location e.g "Fertility Consellor Akowonjo" as the subject of the mail.

 

 

2.) Clinical Embryologist

Job Location: Ikoyi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Perform core embryology procedures, including ICSI, conventional IVF, embryo culture, embryo grading, and embryo cryopreservation.
	Perform oocyte identification, assessment, and handling following retrieval.
	Prepare and assess embryos for fresh and frozen embryo transfer.
	Perform semen analysis, sperm washing, and sperm preparation for IUI, ICSI, and conventional IVF.
	Perform sperm and oocyte cryopreservation, warming, and recovery.
	Maintain accurate laboratory records and specimen identification.
	Monitor laboratory equipment and maintain quality control, safety, and hygiene standards.
	Comply with laboratory SOPs, patient confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulations.


Qualifications and Experience


	Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Biological Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.
	3-5 years of relevant experience in an IVF laboratory.


Key Skills and Competencies:


	Precision and excellent attention to detail.
	High level of manual dexterity and hand eye coordination.
	Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
	Excellent organisational and time management skills.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
	Strong teamwork and communication skills.
	Accuracy in laboratory procedures and documentation.
	Commitment to quality control, patient confidentiality, and laboratory safety.


Application Closing Date: 29th October, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates can apply by sending their CV to: [email protected] using "Clinical Embryologist Ikoyi" as the subject of the email. 

 


3.) Fertility Nurse

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Coordinate and deliver nursing care to patients undergoing fertility evaluations and treatment cycles (e.g., IUI, IVF, ICSI, egg retrieval, embryo transfer).
	Educate patients on treatment protocols, medication administration (e.g., injections), and lifestyle considerations.
	Monitor patients throughout treatment, including ultrasound scans, blood tests, and medication responses.
	Assist with clinical procedures such as egg retrieval, embryo transfer, and intrauterine insemination.
	Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation in patient records and ensure proper consent forms are completed.
	Provide emotional support and counseling referrals as needed throughout the fertility journey.
	Ensure compliance with infection control, quality assurance, and regulatory standards.
	Collaborate with doctors and lab teams for treatment planning and cycle coordination.
	Participate in patient education seminars or informational sessions when required.


Requirements


	Double qualified RN&RM


Salary
N400,000 - N450,000 / month.

Application Closing Date: 2nd November, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position e.g "FertilityNurse"as the subject of the mail.
